decision: HUMAN PORT remains the addressed object/passage layer. COMMS SPINE 0.1 becomes its specialized addressed-conversation instrument: one canonical thread survives signal extraction, human marking, task/response coverage, bot handoff and RETURN without turning derived labels into source truth.
laws: OBJECT IDENTITY != BYTE HASH != PROJECTION ADDRESS
PORT SENSOR OBJECT != BODY OBSERVATION until explicit import
SOURCE THREAD != DERIVED SIGNALS != HUMAN MARKS != RESPONSE
DERIVED COMMUNICATION CUES DO NOT AUTHOR HUMAN INTENT
EVERY PROMOTED COMMS ITEM MUST RETURN TO AN EXACT SOURCE RANGE
promotion_rule: Keep /contact/ simple. Promote deeper mechanisms onto /port/ only when they reduce real interaction/re-entry cost.
